latest.title: SaaS-Bench: Can Computer-Use Agents Leverage Real-World SaaS to Solve Professional Workflows?
latest.summary: This post introduces SaaS-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating whether computer-use agents can complete professional workflows across real-world SaaS applications. It highlights that while agents make partial progress, they resolve fewer than 4% of tasks end-to-end, exposing structural challenges in long-horizon execution, cross-application coordination, and error detection.
